verdict.rationale: Alloy documents outbound webhooks that fire on asynchronous events such as manual reviews. These come with signed authentication and 24-hour exponential-backoff retries, so a developer can push review decisions to an external system. The API reference also points to Investigations endpoints, and workflows can generate investigations. However, no documentation describes syncing investigations with another case-management system, in either direction. Missing for 10: a documented bidirectional investigation/case sync (inbound updates from an external case tool), investigation-specific webhook payloads or status mapping, a dedicated Investigations API description, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can synchronize investigations and decisions with another case-management system
